title: OrientedDet Training Configuration
description: Schema for training config files used by tools/train.py. Supports MMRotate-style _base_ inheritance. Written config.json key order: switches first (enable_*), then sections; within sections switch/type first, then keys with same prefix (e.g. lr_scheduler_type then lr_*, roi_*, rpn_*).

_base_.description: Path(s) to base config(s) to inherit from. Loaded and merged before this config. Paths are relative to the current config file.

model_type.description: Model variant. Must match tools/train.py: oriented_rcnn, rotated_faster_rcnn, or rotated_retinanet.

experiment_timestamp.description: Optional run id; set when saving a training experiment.

source_recipe.description: Path to the training recipe JSON used for this run (set when saving config.json).

source_code_root.description: Framework source tree used at train start (set when saving config.json).

git_commit.description: Full git commit hash of the framework source at train start.

git_describe.description: Output of git describe --dirty --always --tags at train start.

git_dirty.description: True when the framework source tree had uncommitted changes at train start.

git_branch.description: Git branch name at train start (may be HEAD when detached).

git_commit_date.description: Committer date (ISO 8601) of git_commit at train start.

package_version.description: Installed oriented-det package version at train start.

class_map.description: Saved with checkpoints for inference; not required in hand-written training configs.

class_names.description: Saved with checkpoints; optional in hand-written configs.

num_classes.description: Foreground class count; saved with checkpoints, optional in hand-written configs.

format.description: Dataset format. 'dota' expects train_tiles_dir/val_tiles_dir or train_tiles_dirs/val_tiles_dirs. 'airbus_playground' expects annotations_file/split_file.

train_tiles_dirs.description: Optional list of training tile roots (union via ConcatDataset). When set, overrides train_tiles_dir.

val_tiles_dirs.description: Optional list of validation tile roots (union via ConcatDataset). When set, overrides val_tiles_dir.

same_folder.description: If true, DOTA images and annotation .txt files are in the same directory (train_tiles_dir and val_tiles_dir). If false, expect train_tiles_dir/images and train_tiles_dir/labels (and same for val).

overlap.description: Overlap between adjacent tiles in pixels. 0 = none (e.g. DOTA bases); otherwise use a positive even value (e.g. 16 vehicles, 256 planes). Deploy uses an interior margin of overlap/2 px when production.ignore_margin_pixels is null; overlap 0 disables that margin.

val_split_id.description: For Airbus split.csv with integer fold ids: which fold id is treated as validation (default 0). Ignored when split.csv uses legacy train/val strings.

train_includes_val.description: Airbus Playground fold mode only: when true, the train split includes all folds (DOTA trainval parity). Validation still uses val_split_id for monitoring only.

ignore_labels.description: Labels to ignore for Airbus Playground CSV generation/loading.

map_labels.description: Label remapping dictionary for Airbus Playground, e.g. {"taxi":"car"}.

difficult_strategy.description: How to handle DOTA 'difficult' annotations: drop at read-time, ignore (MMRotate-style don't-care), or keep as normal GT.

filter_empty_gt.description: DOTA only: drop tiles with no ground truth after difficult_strategy, allowed_classes, and ignore_labels (MMRotate DOTADataset filter_empty_gt parity). Default false keeps empty tiles.

max_train_samples.description: Cap training samples (for overfitting sanity checks).

max_samples_shuffle_seed.description: When set with max_train_samples or max_val_samples, pick a deterministic random subset (spread across dataset order) instead of the first N indices.

allowed_classes.description: Restrict to these class names. null = all classes.

tile_metrics_csv.description: CSV from save_predictions tile metrics; join on image_id (stem) to oversample hard tiles.

hard_tile_metric_column.description: Column in tile_metrics_csv compared to hard_tile_threshold.

hard_tile_threshold.description: Tiles with metric strictly below this are oversampled.

hard_tile_oversample_factor.description: Sampling weight multiplier for hard tiles (WeightedRandomSampler).

pin_memory.description: Pin memory for faster GPU transfer.

model.description: Model architecture. Keys grouped by prefix: backbone, fpn_*, anchor_*, target_*, roi_*, rpn_*, nms_*, etc.

pretrained_backbone.description: Load ImageNet pretrained weights for backbone.

trainable_layers.description: Number of backbone layers to train. 5 = all layers.

frozen_stages.description: If set, overrides trainable_layers: freeze this many stages from the start (MMRotate: 1 = freeze stage 1, effective trainable_layers=3).

fpn_returned_layers.description: Backbone layers for FPN (1-based). Default [1, 2, 3, 4] = C2-C5 (5 levels); [2, 3, 4] = C3-C5 only (4 levels).

fpn_strides.description: Optional nominal FPN strides for ROI module init and logs. Training/inference derive strides from image size and feature map shapes so anchors and ROI align match the grid; a warning is emitted if this list disagrees with the derived values.

fpn_extra_level.description: RetinaNet: append stride-128 FPN level via 3x3 conv (MMRotate P7).

anchor_scales.description: Anchor scales. Single scale [8] recommended with FPN.

target_means.description: Box regression target means [dx, dy, dw, dh, dangle].

target_stds.description: Box regression target stds [dx, dy, dw, dh, dangle].

roi_loss_type.description: ROI classification loss: cross_entropy or focal.

roi_focal_alpha.description: Focal loss alpha (when roi_loss_type is focal).

roi_focal_gamma.description: Focal loss gamma (when roi_loss_type is focal).

roi_norm_factor.description: Angle scaling for ROI. null for RetinaNet (MMRotate match).

roi_edge_swap.description: Use edge_swap for ROI bbox coder.

roi_proj_xy.description: If true, encode/decode ROI dx/dy in proposal local frame (MMRotate DeltaXYWHTRBBoxCoder proj_xy).

roi_box_reg_angle_weight.description: Weight for angle (5th) in ROI box regression; use > 1 for better alignment.

roi_box_reg_angle_schedule_values.description: Angle SmoothL1 weight per schedule segment. When null, roi_box_reg_angle_weight is constant.

roi_box_reg_iou_weight.description: Extra auxiliary loss weight on decoded ROI positives; see roi_box_reg_iou_loss_type.

roi_box_reg_iou_schedule_epochs.description: 0-based epoch boundaries for roi_box_reg_iou_weight schedule (same convention as final_nms_iou_schedule_epochs).

roi_box_reg_iou_schedule_values.description: Auxiliary IoU loss weight per schedule segment. When null, roi_box_reg_iou_weight is constant.

roi_box_reg_iou_loss_type.description: Auxiliary regression term when roi_box_reg_iou_weight > 0: riou = mean(1 - rIoU); kfiou = Kalman-filter IoU surrogate; probiou = mean ProbIoU (Gaussian BBox).

roi_box_reg_kfiou_fun.description: When roi_box_reg_iou_loss_type is kfiou, overlap mapping: none → 1-KFIoU; ln → -log(KFIoU); exp → exp(1-KFIoU)-1.

roi_box_reg_probiou_mode.description: When roi_box_reg_iou_loss_type is probiou, metric variant: l1 (bounded, default) or l2 (-log(1-l1^2)).

roi_box_reg_main_loss_type.description: Primary ROI box regression loss for Rotated Faster R-CNN: smooth_l1 (encoded) or decoded probiou/riou/kfiou.

roi_box_reg_norm.description: Smooth L1 normalization: sampled_all (MMDet avg_factor over pos+neg) or positives_only (mean over positives).

roi_box_reg_smooth_l1_aux_weight.description: Encoded Smooth L1 aux weight when roi_box_reg_main_loss_type is probiou/riou/kfiou.

retinanet_stacked_convs.description: RetinaNet shared 3x3 conv depth before cls/reg (MMRotate: 4).

box_reg_loss_type.description: RetinaNet: smooth_l1/l1 encoded. FCOS: l1 (encoded), kfiou (decoded KFIoU), or riou (decoded differentiable polygon IoU, 1-IoU). FCOS riou is not sampling pairwise_rotated_iou.

fcos_center_sampling.description: FCOS center sampling around GT centers.

fcos_center_sample_radius.description: FCOS center sample radius in stride units.

fcos_norm_on_bbox.description: Normalize FCOS ltrb targets by FPN stride.

fcos_centerness_on_reg.description: Attach FCOS centerness head to the regression tower.

fcos_scale_angle.description: Learnable Scale on FCOS angle prediction.

fcos_regress_ranges.description: Per-FPN-level (min,max) regress ranges for FCOS assignment. null = MMRotate defaults.

fcos_angle_weight.description: Weight on le90-wrapped angle L1 in FCOS box regression.

fcos_nms_pre.description: Max FCOS candidates kept per FPN level before NMS.

aux_loss_type.description: FCOS decoded auxiliary box loss on positives (centerness-weighted). Use with aux_loss_weight > 0 and L1 primary. Sampling riou is rejected. Includes an aspect-gated heading term unless aux_angle_weight is 0.

aux_loss_weight.description: Weight for FCOS aux_loss_type. 0 disables aux. Typical 0.1 with L1 primary.

aux_angle_weight.description: Weight of the aspect-gated heading term inside FCOS decoded aux (ω sin²(2Δθ)). 0 disables; ignored when aux is off. Typical 1.0.

aux_angle_lambda.description: λ for the GT aspect gate ω = exp(-log²(w*/h*)/λ²). Must be > 0 when aux_angle_weight > 0. λ=1 → ω≈0.62 at AR=2, ω≈0.30 at AR=3.

roi_batch_size_per_image.description: ROI proposals to sample per image for training.

roi_positive_iou_threshold.description: IoU threshold for positive ROI proposals.

roi_negative_iou_threshold.description: IoU threshold for negative ROI proposals.

roi_match_low_quality.description: Force best proposal per GT to positive (MMRotate RCNN: false).

roi_min_pos_iou.description: Min IoU for low-quality ROI matches when roi_match_low_quality is true (MMRotate RCNN assigner min_pos_iou).

rpn_min_size.description: Min proposal side length in pixels. 2-4 filters tiny boxes.

rpn_pre_nms_top_n.description: Max RPN proposals to keep before NMS per level.

rpn_post_nms_top_n.description: Max RPN proposals after NMS (fed to ROI head).

rpn_nms_threshold.description: RPN proposal NMS IoU threshold (Rotated Faster R-CNN / Oriented R-CNN).

rpn_batch_size_per_image.description: RPN anchors to sample per image (MMRotate: 256).

rpn_positive_iou_threshold.description: IoU threshold for positive RPN anchors.

rpn_negative_iou_threshold.description: IoU threshold for negative RPN anchors.

rpn_min_pos_iou.description: Min IoU for best-anchor-per-GT to be positive (MMRotate RPN).

rpn_match_low_quality.description: Force best anchor per GT to positive when IoU >= rpn_min_pos_iou.

use_hbb_for_matching.description: Use axis-aligned (HBB) IoU for RPN/anchor matching (MMRotate RPN stage).

roi_use_hbb_for_matching.description: Oriented R-CNN only: use HBB IoU for ROI-stage matching. Default false (rotated IoU, MMRotate RCNN).

add_gt_as_proposals.description: Append GT boxes to RPN proposals in training (MMRotate default).

final_nms_iou_threshold.description: Final detection NMS IoU threshold after ROI head (distinct from rpn_nms_threshold).

nms_class_agnostic.description: If true, run one oriented NMS on all classes (suppresses overlapping car/truck); if false, NMS per class (default).

final_nms_use_cpu.description: If true, final detection oriented NMS uses exact polygon IoU on CPU (slower; ignores GPU sampling NMS and ORIENTED_DET_ROTATED_BACKEND for that step only).

final_nms_iou_schedule_epochs.description: Epoch boundaries for final detection NMS IoU schedule (same parameter as final_nms_iou_threshold).

final_nms_iou_schedule_values.description: Final NMS IoU values per segment.

max_detections_per_image.description: Max detections to keep per image after final NMS.

inference_pre_nms_score_threshold.description: Pre-NMS score threshold for detection candidates.

roi_inference_top_class_only.description: Two-stage ROI inference: if true, argmax foreground class per proposal (MMRotate-style); if false, keep every class above inference_pre_nms_score_threshold. Prefer false early in training; true for late fine-tune and deployment.

training.description: Training hyperparameters. Keys: lr_scheduler_type (switch) first, then lr_* grouped, then rest.

lr_scheduler_type.description: LR scheduler: null/'multistep'/'step' = MultiStepLR/StepLR; 'reduce_on_plateau' = ReduceLROnPlateau; 'one_cycle' = OneCycleLR (per-step); 'cosine_annealing'/'cosine' = PyTorch CosineAnnealingLR (SGDR restarts if num_epochs > T_max); 'cosine_annealing_with_tail'/'cosine_with_tail' = cosine phase then fixed tail_lr.

lr_scheduler_step_epochs.description: StepLR period in epochs (LR *= gamma every N epochs). Distinct from lr_warmup_steps (optimizer steps).

lr_scheduler_milestones.description: Optional MultiStepLR milestones in epochs. When set, takes precedence over lr_scheduler_step_epochs.

lr_scheduler_gamma.description: Factor by which LR is multiplied at each step (StepLR) or milestone (MultiStepLR).

lr_scheduler_plateau_metric.description: Metric to monitor for ReduceLROnPlateau. Use 'mAP' (mode=max) or 'total_loss' (mode=min).

lr_scheduler_plateau_factor.description: ReduceLROnPlateau: factor by which LR is multiplied when metric plateaus.

lr_scheduler_plateau_patience.description: ReduceLROnPlateau: number of epochs with no improvement before reducing LR.

lr_scheduler_one_cycle_pct_start.description: OneCycleLR: fraction of total steps for warmup phase.

lr_scheduler_cosine_t_max.description: Legacy alias for cosine phase length when lr_scheduler_cosine_epochs is unset. Same meaning as CosineAnnealingLR T_max.

lr_scheduler_cosine_eta_min.description: Minimum LR at end of cosine phase (eta_min).

lr_scheduler_cosine_epochs.description: Cosine decay length in epochs. With tail settings, num_epochs should equal cosine_epochs + tail_epochs.

lr_scheduler_cosine_tail_epochs.description: Fixed-LR tail after cosine (0 = auto from num_epochs - cosine_epochs when longer).

lr_scheduler_cosine_tail_lr.description: Constant LR during tail; default lr_scheduler_cosine_eta_min.

lr_warmup_steps.description: Number of optimizer steps for linear warmup.

lr_scaling_with_accumulation.description: Scale base LR by effective batch size: linear, sqrt, or none.

lr_scale_with_world_size.description: If true, multiply base LR by DDP world size. MMRotate parity mode keeps this false.

use_lr_param_groups.description: If true, use per-module learning rate multipliers (backbone, RPN, ROI, RetinaNet head, other).

lr_mult_rpn.description: LR multiplier for RPN head (ignored for rpn_head.* when lr_mult_head is set).

lr_mult_roi.description: LR multiplier for ROI head (ignored for roi_head.* when lr_mult_head is set).

lr_mult_head.description: Optional LR multiplier for head.* (RetinaNet). When set, rpn_head.* and roi_head.* use the same multiplier (single knob for detector heads); when null, head.* uses lr_mult_other and two-stage heads use lr_mult_rpn / lr_mult_roi.

learning_rate.description: Base learning rate (scaled by gradient accumulation / world size when configured).

gradient_accumulation_steps.description: Accumulate gradients over this many steps; effective batch = batch_size × this.

freeze_backbone_epochs.description: While training loop epoch index epoch < N (0-based), freeze backbone.* (requires_grad=False). ROI head still trains. 0 = disabled.

freeze_rpn_epochs.description: While epoch < N, freeze rpn_head.* on two-stage detectors. No-op without rpn_head (e.g. RetinaNet). 0 = disabled.

loss_weights.description: Per-loss weights, e.g. { "loss_box_reg": 0.5 } to stabilize ROI head.

early_stop_patience.description: If set, stop training after this many epochs without improvement on early_stop_metric (null = disabled).

early_stop_metric.description: Validation metric key for early stopping (e.g. mAP). Skips update when mAP was not computed (-1).

early_stop_min_delta.description: Minimum change to qualify as improvement for early stopping.

early_stop_higher_is_better.description: If null, inferred from metric name (mAP/AP_* = higher).

score_threshold.description: Min confidence for detections and TensorBoard viz.

per_class_score_threshold.description: Optional class_name -> min score; classes not listed use score_threshold.

compute_map_every_n_epochs.description: If >0, compute mAP every N epochs during training (current model). 0 = only at end; final mAP uses best checkpoint when compute_map_final is true.

compute_map_final.description: If true, after training load the best checkpoint and compute mAP once (final mAP uses best model).

extended_gt_metrics.description: If true, compute expensive GT–IoU histogram diagnostics (mean/median/buckets, 0% best-IoU GT count, wrong-class counts) and class-agnostic duplicate rate on post-threshold detections (same schedule as mAP during training).

use_exact_rotated_iou.description: When true, periodic mAP and GT-cover / accuracy matching use exact CPU polygon IoU (Shapely when installed). When false, use GPU sampling IoU (faster, approximate). Does not affect final detection NMS or production/deploy decode.

use_exact_rotated_iou_for_final_map.description: IoU backend for compute_map_final only (best-checkpoint mAP after training). When null, uses use_exact_rotated_iou. Set true for exact publishable final mAP while keeping periodic in-training mAP on GPU sampling.

production.description: Production overrides (deploy, save_predictions): score_threshold and per_class_score_threshold (merge with evaluation); mAP IoU is evaluation.iou_threshold only. Decode/NMS patch model only in load_model_from_checkpoint / deploy / image_demo — not during tools/train.py. Sliding-window: overlap, margin, canvas. Null fields fall back to evaluation/model/dataset or deploy defaults.

score_threshold.description: When set, overrides evaluation.score_threshold for mAP / val matching and deploy display score (resolve_inference_score_threshold).

per_class_score_threshold.description: Per-class floors merged after evaluation.per_class_score_threshold (same keys update/override).

final_nms_iou_threshold.description: Same meaning as model.final_nms_iou_threshold; when set, patches the live model after checkpoint load.

final_nms_use_cpu.description: When set, patches model.final_nms_use_cpu (exact polygon NMS on CPU).

inference_pre_nms_score_threshold.description: Decoder pre-NMS score floor; when set, patches model.inference_pre_nms_score_threshold (or RetinaNet score_threshold).

nms_class_agnostic.description: When set, patches model.nms_class_agnostic (two-stage / RetinaNet where supported).

roi_inference_top_class_only.description: Two-stage only: when set, patches model.roi_inference_top_class_only.

rpn_nms_threshold.description: When set, patches model.rpn_nms_threshold (two-stage proposal NMS).

overlap_pixels.description: Sliding-window overlap in pixels per axis; null = 200 (same default as oriented_det.runtime.inference).

ignore_margin_pixels.description: Interior margin (px): drop detections whose centroid lies in the outer band; null = dataset.overlap/2 (0 disables).

use_first_image_canvas.description: Deploy: expand square canvas from first image (fixed resize); null = false.

stick_to_model_canvas.description: Deploy: always use config target_size; null = true.

log_debug_anchors_proposals.description: Log val/debug_anchors and val/debug_proposals (random val image each epoch with RPN anchors and proposals overlaid). Only applies to RCNN-style models.

vis_score_threshold.description: Min score for boxes in TensorBoard prediction images; null = use evaluation.score_threshold.

load_from_checkpoint.description: Path to checkpoint file (.pth), relative path under project root (e.g. pretrained/...), or hf://<asset> for Hugging Face Hub download when missing.

discover_previous_run.description: If true, when load_from_experiment is null and load_from_checkpoint does not point to an existing file, set load_from_experiment to the newest other run under runs/<model_type>/. If false, never auto-fill (scratch training unless paths are set).

resume_from_checkpoint_epoch.description: When loading from an experiment dir: if true, use latest checkpoint_epoch_*.pth and continue training from that epoch (optimizer/scheduler per load_* flags). If false, prefer best_* checkpoint and usually start at epoch 0 with fresh optimizer unless overridden.

load_optimizer_state.description: When loading a checkpoint, restore optimizer state if present.

load_scheduler_state.description: When resume_from_checkpoint_epoch is true, restore LR scheduler state from checkpoint if true. Set false with lr_warmup_steps=0 to rebuild cosine (see tools/train.py continuation path).

start_epoch.description: Epoch index to start from (overridden when resuming).

best_metric.description: Metric used to save the best checkpoint. Use 'mAP' to save at best validation mAP, or 'total_loss' to save at lowest loss. evaluation.compute_map_final uses the best checkpoint for final mAP.

higher_is_better.description: If true, higher metric value is better (e.g. mAP). If false, lower is better (e.g. total_loss). If null, inferred from best_metric ('mAP' -> true, else false).

load_include_prefixes.description: When loading checkpoint: load only weights whose key starts with one of these prefixes. null = no filter.

load_exclude_prefixes.description: When loading checkpoint: do not load weights whose key starts with one of these prefixes. null = no filter.

loss.description: Loss configuration. Keys: loss_type (switch) first, then rest.

loss_type.description: Experiment-level ROI loss recipe: cross_entropy = plain CE (MMRotate-style), class_weighted = CE with dataset-derived weights, focal = unweighted focal, focal_weighted = focal with dataset-derived weights, none = legacy fallback to model.roi_loss_type.

class_weight_method.description: How to compute class weights from counts.

class_weight_beta.description: effective_num only: beta parameter close to 1.0 for smoother weights.

class_weight_schedule_type.description: Optional schedule for ROI class weights. When set to 'linear_ramp', weights ramp from uniform -> computed weights between start/end epochs.

class_weight_schedule_start_epoch.description: Schedule start epoch (inclusive) for class weight ramp.

class_weight_schedule_end_epoch.description: Schedule end epoch (inclusive-ish). Must be > start_epoch to enable ramp.

class_weight_schedule_power.description: Ramp exponent: 1.0 linear, >1 delays the effect (eases in), <1 speeds it up.

background_weight.description: Optional weight override for background class (index 0) in ROI classifier.

focal_alpha.description: Focal loss alpha (when loss_type is focal or focal_weighted).

focal_gamma.description: Focal loss gamma (when loss_type is focal or focal_weighted).

class_weight_overrides.description: Optional per-class weight overrides, e.g. {"truck": 0.25} to reduce dominant-class bias.

roi_grouped_ce_enabled.description: When true, use coarse-to-fine grouped cross-entropy on the ROI classifier (single-run curriculum).

roi_grouped_ce_groups.description: Maps group name to class names, e.g. {"plane": ["Bomber Aircraft", "Fighter Aircraft", ...]}.

roi_grouped_ce_schedule_type.description: Grouped CE mix schedule: step = grouped until end_epoch then fine CE; linear_ramp = blend grouped→fine from start to end epoch.

roi_grouped_ce_schedule_end_epoch.description: Grouped CE schedule end epoch (step: first fine epoch; ramp: last grouped-heavy epoch).

preprocessing.description: Image preprocessing. Keys: resize_mode (switch) first, then target_size, normalize_*, pad_*, enable_flip_*.

resize_mode.description: "fixed" = stretch to (H,W); "pad" = uniform scale so longer edge equals max(H,W) then zero-pad; "crop" = native-res crop/pad to (H,W).

target_size.description: [H, W] canvas for fixed/pad/crop, or [size] for square canvas (pad/crop).

normalize_mean.description: RGB mean for normalization ([0,1] scale). Default: MMDetection-style.

pad_size_divisor.description: Pad image to multiple of this (training).

enable_flip_horizontal.description: Apply random horizontal flip during training.

enable_flip_vertical.description: Apply random vertical flip during training.

enable_flip_diagonal.description: Apply random diagonal flip (MMRotate RRandomFlip direction=diagonal). With H+V+D enabled, each flip has 25% probability and 25% no flip.

augmentation.description: Albumentations (non-geometric). Keys: limits first, then p_* (probabilities). Only used when enable_albumentation is true.
